summary: G010 T006 cross-process acceptance, compatibility verification, and operation documentation. (1) End-to-end rehearsal entirely through real `python -m orx` CLI subprocesses against a temp project with a deterministic host-session database (ORX_ZCODE_DB stand-in carrying the really-minted attempt nonces) and a local agent stand-in for the permission-blocked CLI executor - zero paid model calls: the completion branch walks start -> partial work (claim via --discover-session + heartbeat + explicit fail with usage booked) -> retry -> stale late delivery of the replaced attempt refused -> pause (orx run gated exit 1, no new dispatch, attempt count frozen) -> host session ends -> new-session resume (same attempt id and nonce, no second executor) -> delivery-gate block -> fix -> same-attempt continuation -> independent agent verdict -> done, with the accepted delivery retransmitted from a brand-new process replaying the persisted receipt byte-for-byte while the database stays unchanged; the cancel branch keeps a live claimed executor at cancel time (listed unconfirmed with observe/recover follow-ups, its heartbeat still accepted), sweeps the unstarted dependent explicitly, converges on the operator's recover --termination-fact, refuses late writes, repeats idempotently, and keeps status/timeline/usage/goal-show history queryable. (2) The matrix additionally covers suppression fix-and-continue through the real CLI (three same-condition blocked rounds -> suppression engaged with baseline fingerprint -> real permission config fix alone changes nothing -> task reverify decision lifted -> next run relaunches and delivers passed; four native_cli usage rows recorded) and unattributable usage with named reasons (host_session_unbound for the sessionless attempt, zcode_unreadable for the session absent from the stand-in db). Per-stage Goal/Run/revision state, execution ownership, events, evidence, usage, and receipts are recorded read-only from SQLite and asserted at every stage boundary. (3) Read-only contract: eleventh amendment adds goal_lifecycle and goal_lifecycle_events queries (new states, event families, times; goal state read from goals.status verbatim), read tests reject writes, and the independent orx-analytics compatibility status is recorded from read-only inspection (SUPPORTED_ORX_SCHEMA 8-12 at commit 3f1b66c; adaptations listed) with scheduling and migration authority explicitly not granted. (4) Operation cookbook in docs/goal-lifecycle.md covers pause, resume, cancel, confirm-termination, reverify, and retransmission (pinned by tests); README lifecycle invariant and observability statement updated within its pinned phrases; orx-controller skill gained the lifecycle-control section; orx-worker definition and orx-agent skill teach retransmission safety. (5) Five-stage report docs/goal-lifecycle-report.md consolidates the six Goal acceptance criteria verbatim with evidence, migration/upgrade-chain facts, the read-only contract, zero-paid labeling of real sources / quasi-real stand-ins / unverified boundaries; the G010 implementation-plan sections were removed from IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md (whole-file deletion is blocked by out-of-scope test_model_docs pins on G004/G006/G007/G008 history, disclosed). The user's uncommitted docs/m1.2-report.md is byte-identical to the T001 baseline disposition digest (top-level sha256 added to user-file-baseline.json so the prescribed check resolves); nothing was staged or committed for it. Design and boundaries: docs/diagnostics/g010/t006-e2e-acceptance.md.
